description: Skelet G09b-01 Build Kit schema freeze

compatibility.instructions: Could the new schema, validator, fixture, tests, or CI step regress any existing contract, consumer, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any missing required field, wrong enum or range, unenforced firewall (path traversal, redistributable unknown/restricted bytes, report mismatch), or validator/test mismatch?

evidence.instructions: Are the fixture tests sufficient for the valid contract plus version, status, report binding, scope, pages, layout, traversal, kind, rights firewall, heuristic, label, and policy negatives?

reliability.instructions: Any unhandled fixture shape, stdlib-only violation, or nondeterminism in the validator?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond schema freeze: job logic, starter generation, REST/MCP/UI, or network dependence?

security.instructions: Any path traversal acceptance, redistributable unknown/restricted/trademarked bytes acceptance, or report-binding bypass in the validator?

state.change: Freeze P09b Build Kit v1 contract before any job logic: JSON schema (manifest, job states, scope budgets, pages, fixed 7-file export layout plus starter/screenshots trees, per-artifact rights with redistributable-permitted firewall, report binding, no-heuristic provenance, synthesis label), stdlib-only validator, valid fixture, 4-test adversarial suite, CI bootstrap step (+3 lines). No implementation, no network.
